description: Stops existing hack.js processes across rooted servers and starts a new set targeting the selected host.
caution: WARNING: Stops existing hack.js processes. This interrupts currently running hack jobs.

description: Ranks eligible hacking targets using maximum money and current security.
caution: Ranking is a heuristic, not a guaranteed highest-profit target.

description: Copies hack.js and launch.js to discovered rooted servers with RAM.
caution: Does not automatically grant root access.

description: Discovers coding contract files on scanned servers.
caution: Finds contracts but does not solve them.

description: Runs the project’s hacking/growing/weakening loop against a selected host.
caution: Requires enough available RAM and a suitable target.

description: Calculates available threads and starts hack.js on the current host.
caution: hack.js must already be present on the server running launch.js.

description: Summarizes active hack.js jobs, thread counts and target money/security.
caution: Reads running processes; it does not start or stop them.

description: Scans connected servers and reports their connection information.
caution: Read-only; does not grant access or alter servers.

description: Scans servers and attempts port-opening and root access using available programs.
caution: Changes in-game root access. Requires sufficient programs and hacking prerequisites.

description: Attempts authentication on a specified in-game Dark Net target.
caution: Only works where the game provides ns.dnet APIs; avoid exposing passwords in screenshots.

description: Authenticates to a target, copies Dark Net helper scripts and launches reconnaissance.
caution: Changes in-game state; referenced helper files must be available.

description: Lists nearby in-game Dark Net nodes with depth and required Charisma.
caution: Requires ns.dnet support in the current game.

description: Uses the game’s heartbleed mechanic to request log data from a target.
caution: Game mechanic only, not real-world exploitation. API availability and behavior require in-game verification.

description: Shows depth, Charisma requirement and accessibility information for a Dark Net target.
Probes nearby nodes and attempts the game’s log-scraping method for reconnaissance.
caution: Requires ns.dnet support; output may include in-game log information.

description: Lists nearby Dark Net servers, depth and required Charisma.
Scans the Bitburner network from home, records parent routes and server properties, and writes a JSON file for preview and import in Server Manager.
arguments: No arguments. After running, inspect network-discovery.txt with cat and copy its JSON into a local UTF-8 text file for upload.
caution: Read-only discovery. The script saves a text file inside Bitburner but does not hack or modify servers. If transferring JSON, do not alter its keys or values.
